opportunities.title: Trezor's Third Breach Notice in a Row: Why 'Cold Storage' Companies Keep Leaking Warm Data
opportunities.why_now: Trezor just disclosed a second wave of 67K affected US customers from the same ShipMonk fulfillment breach, and it's being covered as routine news rather than a pattern.
opportunities.angle: Analysis piece tracing the breach timeline and arguing that hardware wallet security theater ends at the shipping label — pair with a checklist on verifying device authenticity post-breach

opportunities.title: The Coldcard Hacker's THORChain Move Is a Live Masterclass in Laundering — Here's the On-Chain Trail
opportunities.why_now: The thief converted stolen BTC to ETH via THORChain within days of the theft, giving a fresh, traceable case study while it's still unfolding.
opportunities.angle: On-chain forensic walkthrough (screenshots of the swap tx, THORChain routing) framed as 'this is how they always do it' — evergreen educational content wrapped in breaking news

opportunities.title: Full Sail Is Dead Because an Oracle Lied: The Switchboard Incident Nobody Priced In

opportunities.angle: Post-mortem breakdown of oracle manipulation as an attack surface that's still underpriced by users chasing yield on new L1 DeFi — cautionary tale format

opportunities.title: Tether Just Got Sued for Doing Exactly What Everyone Warned It Could Do

opportunities.angle: Explainer on Tether's freeze authority and legal precedent risk — 'not your keys, not your coins' extended to stablecoins, written for readers who already assumed this was coming

opportunities.title: G7 Says Quantum Computers Are Coming for Your Coins — the Industry Still Has No Real Fix
